payload.title: Public docs on p.apyr.us as each milestone lands
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** AnthusAI/Papyrus-web is private: its CI and deploy run in AWS. Content PRs merge without screenshot approval. Add a page on notification options when M3 ships: subscribing, the channels that really exist then, turning things off, what is logged, no tracking. Slack and Discord get added only when live. No speed bragging. Terminology: never 'Notification Center' for this; Papyrus `docs/feature-names.md` gets the entry.

**Acceptance.**
Page live; every claim traced to a shipped story.

**Depends on:** P_ROLLOUT
